method.read: The completed Plain workspace, read-only. No requirement identifier appears anywhere in it, because a Plain codebase carries no citations; every reach below is decided by one artifact naming another, never by a tag.
method.counted: Seven edges whose populations and reaches are decidable from the artifacts themselves.
method.uncounted: The six requirement-rooted edges. Their eligibility is a judgement over 73 requirement anchors, and the delivered code names none of them, so each one has to be read and decided. Counting them from section titles would be an estimate wearing a measurement's clothes, and this file records what was measured rather than what could be guessed.
method.corrections: Two first-pass errors are already folded in. `modelToDto` first read zero because the schema writes `todo_users` where the published types write `IUser`. `columnToProperty` first counted 62 columns because relation fields were counted as columns; a relation names another model and carries no value a type could publish, so the population is the 50 scalar columns.

modelToDto: todo_delivery_effects, which no published type represents
hookToScreen: two of the twenty-four hooks are called by no screen component
columnToProperty: foreign keys: todo_profiles.todo_user_id, todo_sessions.todo_user_id, todo_todos.todo_user_id, todo_todo_histories.todo_todo_id, todo_recovery_requests.todo_user_id, todo_delivery_effects.todo_user_id
internal lifecycle: todo_sessions.expires_at, todo_sessions.revoked_at, todo_todos.updated_at, todo_todos.content_version, todo_recovery_requests.expires_at, todo_recovery_requests.consumed_at
history change flags: title_changed, description_changed, start_date_changed, due_date_changed
delivery effect internals: recipient, kind, payload

modelToDto.why: A reading counts a model reached when its information arrives on the published surface under any name; a name-stem rule counts it reached only when a published type is named after it. They disagree on the models a workspace publishes under another shape — a session as an authorization, a recovery proof as a recovery request. Neither figure is published until the disagreement is settled by reading the candidates.
